title: Rebase planning and new immutable candidate
summary: Compare an old Extension with old/new versions of the same Base, classify unchanged/portable/absorbed/conflicting edits, and optionally write a new Extension version to an absent destination.

replaceability.why: The adapter and layering machinery are the Host foundation. If this machinery could be replaced by a creator layer, automatic fallback to the original could not be guaranteed. The Lucs carried by open protocols have their own replacement classes.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, self-Luc spec v0.3, 2026-10-18; interface charter rule 6, 2026-10-22

reach.notes: Trusted Host machinery, not authority granted to a Luc. Package calls remain bounded by their resolved permissions, Host APIs and editable scope.

operations.name: plan_rebase

old_base_input.description: Verified immutable LucArtifact or source path; manifest shape is docs/luc/schemas/artifact-manifest-v1.schema.json.

new_base_input.description: Verified immutable LucArtifact or source path; manifest shape is docs/luc/schemas/artifact-manifest-v1.schema.json.

extension_input.description: Verified immutable LucArtifact or source path; manifest shape is docs/luc/schemas/artifact-manifest-v1.schema.json.

operations.notes: No deadline. Read-only plan; package loading, patch application and candidate resolve may propagate other distribution errors. Never activates.

operations.name: public
operations.notes: No deadline is enforced by this synchronous Python seam. Retrying a read observes the current state.

operations.name: agent_handoff
operations.notes: No deadline is enforced by this synchronous Python seam. Retrying a read observes the current state.

operations.name: write_rebase_candidate
operations.notes: No deadline. Output Path returned; destination must not exist. A retry after success refuses rather than replacing the immutable candidate.

invariants.text: A rebase never edits the old Base or Extension and cannot overwrite the candidate destination.
The agent handoff explicitly has activation_allowed=false.

break: The operation rejects invalid input, integrity, authority or binding state as described by its operation.

conformance.notes: Existing tests listed here were inspected, not run for this documentation task. The area checker validates the contract files; it does not exercise runtime behavior.
